text:
Type: white metal stacking stool
Use: extra seating, quick perch, side surface; dining room, kitchen, home office, bedroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: white powder-coated steel legs, molded plastic seat with round holes
Colors: white
Shape: round flat seat dotted with round holes, four straight slim tube legs angling slightly outward, stackable, compact and light
Feel: clean, simple, airy, casual
Goes with: white or pale walls, light wood tables, colorful accents; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern kitchens and dining rooms

product.name: MARIUS
product.description: The stool can be stacked, so you can keep several on hand and store them on the same space as one.
